what: task 1903 plan section 8 — the O(Delta) measurement

parameters.notes: drive record read from tools/odelta/run.d:451-536; Producer is tools/odelta/run.d (NOT a tests/unit/undo_parity_l*_test.d file); the fixture's cells carry a `cell` key, not a `name`, so the cell names A / B-now / B-armed / C are used verbatim. These cells drive raw mesh KERNELS, not commands, so the op ids are the kernel names. Excluded as stand: the grid sizes nA=316 (:463) and nB=100 (:482), and the face masks (:466-468, :485, :523-525), which are the operand. Excluded as instrument config, not operation parameters: the MeshEditScope flags, the wantsFaceReindex arm/disarm bool that is the ONLY difference between B-now and B-armed (:501-510), and Revert.attempt/refuse. Defaults recorded and marked here: deleteFacesByMask keepOrphans=false / keepFloatingEdges=false (source/mesh.d:5779-5780), extrudeFacesByMask smooth=false and uvWall=SweepU (source/mesh_ops/extrude.d:3161-3162) -- default, not explicitly set. extrudeFacesByMask's `distance` = 0.25f IS an explicit literal (:486, :526).

build: dmd -i, BOUNDS-CHECKED. -release is FORBIDDEN for this instrument: it compiles out the array bounds check that found the B-now out-of-bounds write. See tools/odelta/run.d.
pinned: the byte and alloc columns and deltaRoundTrip; the ms and collection columns are NOT — see fieldNotes

fieldNotes.snapshotRecordMs: INFORMATIONAL — SERIAL wall time on the measuring host (the driver pins the task pool); a lane comparing it compares loadavg
fieldNotes.deltaUndoMs: INFORMATIONAL — wall time; null means the cell refused to revert (see deltaRoundTrip)
fieldNotes.snapshotAllocBytes: PINNED — GC.stats().allocatedInCurrentThread across the record; monotone, reproduces run to run. NOT the live set.
fieldNotes.snapshotCollections: INFORMATIONAL — GC.profileStats().numCollections; when the collector runs is not a property of the edit
fieldNotes.deltaRoundTrip: PINNED — yes | no | not-attempted. no means a measured lossy record; not-attempted means the replay is unsafe in this tree and the cell refused.

stand: tests/unit/fixtures.d :: makeTaggedGridFull(n), Hide bit cleared — see tools/odelta/run.d

provenance.harness: tools/odelta/run.d, in-process against vibe3d's own MeshSnapshot/MeshEditDelta (see the file's own `build`/`stand` fields)
provenance.notes: Byte/alloc counts of vibe3d's own undo paths; no reference editor involved. captured_utc is the commit date of the last commit that touched this file on disk (`git log --follow`), since this fixture carries no own `producedBy` SHA to anchor on.
